scenarios.name: Late Smart Sports Multi-View result cannot replace a newer drawer destination
Extended background setting starts native foreground service and Normal releases it
Profile selection isolates favorites and rejects an incorrect PIN
System file picker result plays a content URI and preserves section on return
Player lock blocks touch and unlock restores controls; video long press has no Channels popup
Channel PiP Off prevents framework PiP and returns to the same decoder
Fullscreen Display changes the existing decoder and retains its selected override
Recording survives actual Activity recreation, stops, and a second recording can start
Sports Watch Live and Smart Multi-View resolve fixture broadcasts into real playback
Trailer callback hands the provider URL to Android and keeps Movies ownership
Diagnostics action exports a readable ZIP through Android content provider
Additional settings callbacks change real policies and persist across process restart
